request.description: Cancels a job. Note: you can cancel only a scheduled or a job that is already running. The user requesting must be the owner of the job to cancel.

variable.description: (Required) The job id to lookup information about.

request.description: Returns the information related to the provided job id. This endpoint can for example be polled to get the state and progress of the job in real time.

request.description: List all existing jobs. Jobs are task executed asynchronously in the background. You can use the `get_job` endpoint to read the current progress of the job. The available query parameters depend on the job type selected via the `type` parameter. Each job type may support additional type-specific filter parameters.
